summary: Install from GitHub source when testing features or working on core changes; only run devel if modifying ansible-core or trying in-development features, since it can be unstable.
questions: Should I run the devel branch of Ansible in production?
When should I install Ansible from source?

answer_card.title: When to use the devel branch
answer_card.answer_md: Only install and run `devel` if you're modifying `ansible-core` or trying features under development. It changes fast and can become unstable at any time, so it's not for normal use.
